data.title: Top 3 Price Predictions: Bitcoin, Ethereum, Ripple – BTC eyes breakout, ETH consolidates, XRP finds stability | FXStreet
data.description: Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH) and Ripple (XRP) move toward the key technical levels on Wednesday, which could determine the next directional bias. BTC is near the 50-day Exponential Moving Average (EMA), ETH trades sideways while XRP is showing signs of stabilization.
